note: Stocks named in the last 21 days of public Telegram channels, beside what the same stock did that session and which side of its chain saw the largest open-interest increase. A mention is not a prediction.

cautions.image_posts: 102 of 149 posts in this window carry no usable text - they are screenshots, usually of a PCR table. Nothing is extracted from those, so a silent channel may simply be an image-only channel.
cautions.not_accuracy: Nothing here says whether a channel was right. That needs what the stock did AFTER the post, which this file does not compute.
cautions.text_only: Ticker matching runs on post text. A stock named in an image, or spelled out in words, is not counted.
cautions.copyright: Only the fact that a channel named a symbol is stored, with the market's own numbers beside it. The posts themselves are not reproduced here or on the site.
